title: The Moon Room's goal for a slow win
description: With one win timed at 11:40, the high scores room has the time's silver trophy but no Moon Room door. The player climbs the ledges beside the trophies: the Changing Room and the Stars Room read LOCKED, but beside the trophy the Moon Room's goal shows as if it were unlocked.
